t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms each type of gnomes gives changes throughout the game, and the pattern is based on colour alone. However to work out which colour gnome offers a higher number of mushrooms, you should use the x1 multiplier and when it shows a x5 multiplier, make sure you are going with a safe bet and choose a gnome you are confident will give you more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Use the colour of the gnomes to help you keep track of their values. However this value changes overtime, but use the colours as a reference to which gnome may be worth more. The 1x multiplier is a good time to find out the current value of a gnome if you are unsure and the x5 multiplier is useful to build up points when you are certain of a gnome's current value.
